How do you check a decision in UYAP Emsal?

Read the citation, choose the right search, enter its numbers and compare every detail with the full decision.

Published
23 Nov 2026
Updated
23 Nov 2026
Author
MESA contributors
Reading time
5 minutes
On this page
  1. Which search should you use?
  2. Read the citation first
  3. Search step by step
  4. Compare the result
  5. What a search result does and does not show
  6. Sources
Short answer

Open UYAP Emsal Karar Arama, choose the court group, enter the docket and decision numbers or a date range, and compare the result with the citation. Use Yargıtay Karar Arama first when the citation names a Yargıtay board or chamber.

Which search should you use?#

Citation namesStart with
A Yargıtay board or chamberYargıtay Karar Arama
A regional court of appeal (BAM) civil chamberUYAP Emsal Karar Arama
A first-instance civil courtUYAP Emsal Karar Arama
Scope of this guide

This guide explains a checking method and is not legal advice. MESA Law is a reference application and does not verify decisions for you. The lawyer or person relying on a citation remains responsible for checking it.

Read the citation first#

A Turkish decision citation usually has this pattern. The example uses placeholders and is not a real decision.

PartPatternMeaning
CourtX. Hukuk DairesiThe court or chamber
DocketYYYY/NNNN E.The case file number (esas)
DecisionYYYY/NNNN K.The decision number (karar)
DateDD.MM.YYYY T.The decision date (tarih)

Two quick checks can reveal an error before you search. The docket year cannot be later than the decision year, and the decision number’s year should normally match the year of the decision date.

Search step by step#

UYAP Emsal Karar Arama has a detailed query form with keyword, court, docket number, decision number, start date, end date and sort order fields.

  1. Choose the court group, such as Bam Hukuk Mahkemeleri or Hukuk Mahkemeleri.
  2. Enter the year and sequence of the docket number.
  3. If there is no result, clear it and enter the decision number.
  4. Narrow the search with a start and end date around the cited date.
  5. Try a distinctive phrase from the quotation.
  6. Complete any security step the site shows yourself, then open the decision.

Compare the result#

  • Court and chamber are the same
  • Docket year and number are the same
  • Decision year and number are the same
  • Decision date is the same
  • The quoted passage appears in the text
  • The passage supports the stated legal point

What a search result does and does not show#

A result is not the end of the check

Finding a decision confirms that a matching record exists in that search. It does not show that the decision is final, still followed or applicable to your facts.

If nothing appears, do not conclude that the citation is fake from that alone. Check the numbers, try the other official search and ask for a copy from whoever supplied the citation. For the full review, follow the AI-cited Yargıtay decision guide.

Sources#

  1. UYAP Emsal Karar Arama
  2. Yargıtay Karar Arama
